about: PhysicsMind evaluation set. The first 100 were written 15 Nov 2026 before PhysicsMind was run on any of them; the 40 on time to the top, time of flight and range (flight_and_range E01-E26, ambiguous C21-C30, outside D21-D24) were added later that day, also before the solver could answer them. D01, D02, D03 and D20 moved from outside to flight_and_range. Each solvable item lists what it asks for (asks). It lands on the ground, h0 below the launch point; t_top = u_y/g, t_flight = (u_y + sqrt(u_y^2 + 2 g h0))/g, range = u_x t_flight with u_x = u cos(angle). Givens were converted to SI by hand; expected heights come from h = u_y^2 / 2g with u_y = u sin(angle from the horizontal), the given vertical speed, or g times the time to the top. Angles are degrees from the horizontal (90 = straight up). g is 9.8 m/s^2 unless given.
